proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11225 compares Prakrit vaḍḍa, Hindi baṛā/baḍḍā, Marwari baṛo and Awadhi baṛkā. Its addenda derive vaḍra by extraction from formations such as evaḍa/kevaḍa, ultimately involving -vant plus -ḍa; this is not a simple direct descent from vṛddha. Regional vowel and liquid variation remains for triage.
